visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Search Always Starts at Index 0
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The array 64, 25, 12, 22, 11 should be sorted to [11,12,22,25,64], but the program prints [12,11,22,25,64].

solution.explanation: In each round the minimum is searched only in the unsorted part, so the candidate must start at the first unsorted index i. Starting at 0 compares against the already sorted front and swaps a sorted item back.
